_about: FOOTSTEPS (Watch-HostRender Set-RoomFootsteps, BootHd.cs Footsteps; 2026-10-14). What each FLOOR texture sounds like underfoot: stone, tile, wood, metal or water. Most floors are the generic 'floor' material in _materials.json (stone by default), so the painted floors that are really tile or wood are named here by texture name (without its number), judged by eye from the art. A texture not named here goes by its material: wood -> wood, polished/glass -> tile, iron/copper/brass/gold -> metal, water/slime -> water, anything else -> stone. A room's own "footsteps" block (rooms\<ROOM>.json) adds to or overrides this: { "default": "wood", "<texture>": "tile" }, or false for no footsteps in that room. Changing this file does not change how anything looks.
